blocks: ## T01 - no engine edit while a map review runs (FR-001, SC-001)
## T02 - a question for the GM goes through escalation-check (FR-002, SC-002)
## T03 - gm-assistant's main tree is not edited from here (FR-003, SC-003)
## T04 - a reroll says whether it moved the map, against HEAD (FR-004, SC-004)
## T05 - the records and the docs (FR-005, SC-005)
## T06 - found while working: `make guard-edit` refused every hook (constitution XIV)

decisions.summary: D167 counts an unfinished map-review agent as live only while its transcript is younger than agent-stall's two-day bound; an older unfinished one stops refusing engine edits with no TaskStop and no ack
decisions.why: FR-001 as accepted: every map-review agent this session launched that has not FINISHED counts as live, stalled or not, and a stalled one refuses until TaskStop then ack. The bound adds a fourth exit the spec does not carry, unlabeled. Not impossible without it (the ack route the plan itself names still works for a dead agent); not implied by the GM's words (the request says 'while a review is running' and sets no staleness window, and the spec resolved 'stalled' the other way); literal application costs one ack, which does not defeat the purpose. That agent-stall uses the same bound is a consistency argument. Fix: drop the bound from D167 (and the T01 test list), or amend FR-001 and re-review it.

decisions.summary: New guard engine-freeze-hooks.sh with decider lib/hm_engine_freeze.py; session subagents from transcript_path; agentType in REVIEW_AGENTS_RE; finished = 'finished': true or last record an assistant end_turn; passes after TaskStop+ack; engine paths from delta.is_engine() in this session's clone; stalled agents named with the ack command; no token escape
decisions.why: Each element is FR-001's own text or the mechanism for it (R2 measured that meta.json often lacks 'finished', so end_turn is the reading of FINISHED). FR-001 gives no escape beyond waiting, TaskStop or ack. The map-review-only scope is the accepted spec's, not a plan decision.

decisions.summary: Detector in lib/hm_gm_question.py scored by measure/detect.py: ask phrases or a '?' line with you/your/I, outside code, block quotes and quoted text; 'since the GM's last message' = an Agent tool_use with subagent_type escalation-check after the last user record with text; blocked once per final message keyed by hash; review-armed branch unchanged
decisions.why: FR-002 asks for a narrow, measured detector, a refusal once per message, and the filter-since-last-GM-message pass; the plan supplies exactly that. The detector's quality is FR-002's measurement in research.md, not a fidelity ruling.

decisions.summary: gm-tree-hooks.sh: Edit/Write/NotebookEdit by file_path; Bash by write targets only (redirection, tee, sed -i, last argument of cp/mv) via hookmatch.py's splitter; path in tree = resolved under /host-l7r-repo/gm-assistant/ and not under .clones/; Bash escape GM_TREE_OK: <reason>, none for Edit/Write; rest of /host-l7r-repo stays writable
decisions.why: Write-target forms, the .clones/ exclusion and the Bash-only escape with a reason are FR-003 verbatim. Scoping to gm-assistant alone is the request's item 3 ('No edits inside the gm-assistant tree').

decisions.summary: maps_moved.py: git diff --quiet HEAD per tracked pool manifest plus untracked manifests; prints one line per differing manifest or 'no pool manifest moved against HEAD'; make map calls it with --only for its own map
decisions.why: FR-004 and the request's item 4 ('a make target that diffs the manifests against HEAD'). An untracked manifest differs from HEAD, so including it is the requirement, not an addition.

decisions.summary: The Summary frames T04 as 'one printed comparison' rather than a guard: a report that never refuses, its test in tests/tooling/test_maps_moved.py, no guard_log
decisions.why: Narrows against SC-005's 'four companions' and FR-005's per-guard records, but the GM's own words for item 4 are 'a make target that diffs the manifests against HEAD, rather than a habit'. That is a report, not a refusal, and a report that always prints has nothing to log as a firing. Note, not a block: SC-005 still reads 'make hooks-test green with the four companions', so either make hooks-test runs test_maps_moved.py or the session reconciles SC-005's wording; T05's done line must show which.

decisions.summary: Docs and records after T01-T04: guards.md rows, guard_log, rules that said 'remember' point at the tooling, l7r/diagram/CLAUDE.md's reroll line names make maps-moved
decisions.why: FR-005 as written.

decisions.summary: T06, found while working: hm_guard_permit.py's _GUARD pattern reads /scripts/(hooks/)?<name>-hooks.sh, so make guard-edit grants the permit the guard-file guard demands for scripts/hooks/
decisions.why: Not one of the four requested items, and not a narrowing: a tooling bug fix (constitution XIV) that T02's own edit of escalation-hooks.sh hit, reaching only the permit pattern and adding no new behavior, refusal or default. No fidelity ruling attaches.

decisions.summary: Measured-before-planning conclusions: finished read from transcript as well as meta.json; the new tree guard scoped to gm-assistant because intake writes academic-sources
decisions.why: Matches request item 3 and FR-001/FR-003; both carry a dated method (one-shot label), so the figures are reviewable.

decisions.summary: The new write guard covers /host-l7r-repo/gm-assistant only; the rest of /host-l7r-repo (academic-sources intake) stays writable.
decisions.why: Request item 3 names the gm-assistant tree and nothing wider; FR-003 is scoped the same way.

decisions.id: Constitution Check: DIRECT route, tooling only
decisions.summary: Lands by the direct route; no engine path, no map moves.
decisions.why: The request is four tooling guards; none touches the engine or a map.

decisions.summary: The engine-freeze refusal has no escape token; the routes are wait, draft outside the clone, or TaskStop then ack.
decisions.why: Stricter than nothing and exactly FR-001's named routes; request item 1 asks for no engine edits while a review runs.

decisions.summary: engine-freeze-hooks.sh + hm_engine_freeze.py: every map-review agent of this session not finished (finished flag, end_turn, or ack after TaskStop), stalled or not and however old, blocks an engine-path Edit/Write/NotebookEdit in the session's clone; review set and engine list read from their single copies.
decisions.why: The earlier round's narrowing (the two-day age bound) is struck; what remains is FR-001 as written: all unfinished reviews count, a stalled one is named with the TaskStop+ack route and passes after it. Non-engine paths and non-review agents passing is FR-001's own scope.

decisions.id: T02 exits: once per message, review-armed branch unchanged
decisions.summary: Blocked once per final message keyed by its hash; an escalation-check since the GM's last message passes; the existing review-armed branch is untouched.
decisions.why: FR-002 says refused ONCE per message; request item 2 asks that the guard also fire without a review, which this adds without removing the existing branch.

decisions.summary: Detector in lib/hm_gm_question.py: ask phrases or a '?' line with you/your/I, outside code, block quotes and quoted text; 'since the GM's last message' = an Agent tool_use with subagent_type escalation-check after the last user record carrying text; scored by measure/detect.py.
decisions.why: FR-002 asks for a narrow detector measured for hit rate and recall; excluding quoted text is detector design whose cost shows in the measured recall, not a carve-out of the rule.

decisions.summary: Edit/Write refused with no escape (the clone is the route); Bash refused with a GM_TREE_OK: <reason> escape.
decisions.why: FR-003 gives the Bash refusal an escape for the GM's say-so and none to Edit/Write; request item 3 is specifically that Edit and Write there pass today.

decisions.summary: gm-tree-hooks.sh: Edit/Write/NotebookEdit by file_path; Bash by write target only (>, >>, tee, sed -i, cp/mv destination) via hookmatch's splitter; in-tree = resolved path under /host-l7r-repo/gm-assistant/ and not under its .clones/.
decisions.why: The write-target list is FR-003's list verbatim. Excluding .clones/ is implied by the GM-approved rule's own name (gm_assistant_edits_from_clone): the clone is the compliant route, not the tree the rule protects.

decisions.summary: maps_moved.py: git diff --quiet HEAD per tracked pool manifest plus untracked ones; make maps-moved lists all; make map prints one line for its own map via --only; a report, never a refusal.
decisions.why: Request item 4 asks for a make target diffing manifests against HEAD; FR-004 asks for exactly the two outputs. Reporting rather than refusing is what the request named ('a make target ... rather than a habit').

decisions.summary: Guard table rows, guard_log firings, hooks-test suites, and the remember-this docs (including CLAUDE.md's reroll line) pointed at the tooling.
decisions.why: FR-005; enforcement and records of what was asked.

decisions.summary: Fix hm_guard_permit.py's _GUARD pattern to /scripts/(hooks/)?<name>-hooks.sh so make guard-edit grants the permit for hooks under scripts/hooks/.
decisions.why: Adds rather than narrows: a found-while-working repair needed to edit escalation-hooks.sh for T02 by the sanctioned route; it removes no part of what was asked.
